_comment: Commits whose content will never reach main, adjudicated with a reason. Every entry is printed by deploy-drift whether or not the check is otherwise red, and stays visible until the branch carrying it is deleted. An entry without a written reason is rejected: this is an adjudication record, not a mute switch.
